decisions.reason: Close to the established offer and inexpensive to keep, the option remains open while demand uncertainty resolves.
Similar to existing products and low cost to retain, the option is kept open as its prospects remain uncertain but not unfavorable.
Distant from the core offer and after three years without clear traction, the option's value is unlikely to be realized, so it is abandoned.
